annotations.title: Check a listing for filtered words

description:
Use before someone posts a listing in a Moda group, or when their post was declined, to find words that Moda's automatic filters decline.
text: the full listing as it will be posted. group: optional slug of the group it is for; leave it out to check every group.
Returns JSON: each filtered word found, the groups whose filter catches it, words hidden with symbols or spacing, and the other common reasons a post is declined that no word check can see. An empty list means no filtered words, not a guarantee the post goes up.
